meta.name: Life Hill Gayi
meta.description:
﻿Siblings turn rivals when they are put on an inheritance race by reviving a down-in-the-dumps hotel in the hills. Who will emerge victorious?

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6

videos.title: Welcome to Panchmoli
videos.overview: Their grandpa's condition to restore an old hotel puts Dev and Kalki in a fix. How will these city-bred siblings prove themselves to inherit the family's wealth?

videos.title: Naukriyan Hi Naukriyan
videos.overview: As Dev and Kalki try to adapt to village life, they must hire staff to run their villa. Can they win the respect of the quirky locals and run their hotel smoothly?

videos.title: Kaphal
videos.overview: Dealing with the staff's problems leaves Kalki frustrated. Dev motivates Hima's irate workers with incentives at her organic farm. Meanwhile, where are Kripal and Himalaya?

videos.title: Shh… Koi Hai… Shayad
videos.overview: Dev and Kalki face many challenges as people throng the hotel after the news of a ghost spreads like wildfire. This becomes a turning point for the siblings.

videos.title: Rupsa Ramoti
videos.overview: The hotel lights up for the village chief's daughter's wedding. Himalaya gets smitten by the groom's mother, but a theft ruins the festive occasion.

videos.title: Bad Parent
videos.overview: Dev and Kalki are given a final challenge, and Himalaya decides to help them. Before Prithvi declares his verdict, the siblings must deal with absolute chaos.
